summary: Makes the point that the Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI) does not tie Internet number resources to the real-world identity of whoever holds them. The document states that RPKI does not associate resources with the identity of their holder, correcting a common misunderstanding. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: A key card proves you may open a door, not who you really are. RPKI works that way: it shows who holds a block of addresses, not their real name.

questions: what does rpki certify about internet number resources
